comments.story: Ask HN: How do you organize/track your personal goals?
comments.why: Random-looking goals work if you devote yourself fully; new paradigm.
comments.text: That should be the real question. All else is just a consequence of being motivated enough to achieve that particular goal. You are probably fine already, but if you feel that you want more, I would suggest to get some inspiration from a new paradigm you never did before. I've seen this lately, and while he did come up with rather random looking goals, it seems it doesn't matter what they are if you devote yourself fully to them. [VIDEO]
